def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    marker_color=min(counts, key=counts.get)
    markers=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker_color]
    mr=min(r for r,c in markers); mc=min(c for r,c in markers)
    shape={(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in markers}
    sh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; sw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if (r,c)==(mr,mc):
                continue
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
